canonical_findings.evidence: GitPackSource requires a canonical manifest before returning raw content.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Raw transport and canonical validation are conflated.

canonical_findings.evidence: The source result keeps requested ref and discards exact commit metadata.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Resolved immutable source identity is missing.

canonical_findings.evidence: Limits run after Git clone and checkout.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Transport is not bounded before materialization.

canonical_findings.evidence: Git tree modes are discarded before validation.
Run Skill resources and resolver are process-global first-party projections.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Manager bindings do not feed a per-Run Project Skill projection.

canonical_findings.evidence: Existing lifecycle is singular and separately durable across files, DB and registry.
Current Settings confirmation is an adapter boolean against in-memory state.
canonical_findings.root_cause: No shared durable host confirmation receipt exists.

canonical_findings.evidence: Project relocation advances revision without a Capability binding transition.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Revision-aware scope lacks defined predecessor semantics.

decisions.rationale: Split raw transport from canonical pack validation.
Return host-issued exact commit and raw tree digest evidence.
Static reading cannot prove a hard cross-platform Git transport byte/disk ceiling.
Inspect exact tree modes before streaming regular blobs.
Prove a Manager-backed per-Run Project Skill projection and cold-start resolver seam.
Define one BatchInstallAggregate across all authoritative projections.
Define one durable host-owned install decision and receipt.
Fail closed on revision advance; no implicit migration within approved scope.

required_spikes.question: Can Git CLI enforce a hard pre-materialization network/object-store ceiling cross-platform?
required_spikes.fallback: Use bounded GitHub archive download pinned to resolved commit, then validate archive before extraction.

required_spikes.question: Can current Hub/Store and resolver contracts project a Project-bound instruction pack into a fresh Run without process-global mutation?
required_spikes.fallback: Add a Manager-backed ProjectSkillProjection and Run-scoped composite resolver.

plan_actions: Split source transport and canonicalization contracts.
Define revision advance as fail-closed with reinstall in current scope.
Add per-Run Project Skill projection and resolver fence.
Run and record both required spikes before closure.
